summary: R3M Engineering is a 27-person consulting engineering firm founded in 1999, based in Old Bridge, NJ, that designs and oversees water, wastewater, pump-station and pipeline infrastructure for New Jersey municipal authorities, utilities and private clients. Intake is essentially phone/fax plus a web contact form, and hiring runs through a general email inbox rather than an applicant tracking system. The firm is actively recruiting at senior level (five-plus engineer job pages on its own site) while carrying large capital programs such as a $68M flood-mitigation rebuild of the MCUA Sayreville pump station, which won an ACEC New Jersey 2022 Engineering Excellence Honor Award.

facts.fact: Founded in 1999; multi-disciplined consulting engineering firm specializing in water and wastewater solutions for public and private entities, serving New Jersey authorities, utilities, municipalities and private clients.
Office is at 1405 Route 18 South, Suite 208, Old Bridge, NJ 08857; main phone (732) 679-7100, fax (732) 679-7110.
Firm's ACEC New Jersey member profile lists 27 employees, disciplines of civil, environmental, mechanical, structural and process engineering, and names Michael J. Samuel, P.E. as primary contact.

Homepage and projects page state R3M was an ACEC New Jersey 2022 Engineering Excellence Honor Award recipient, for the Flood Mitigation and Permanent Restoration of the Sayreville Pump Station (Middlesex County Utilities Authority), described as a $68M project restoring a 340 MGD pump station damaged during Hurricane Sandy.

Service lines listed on the site include process control and instrumentation, regulatory coordination and funding assistance, hurricane response and recovery, wastewater treatment, pump stations, infrastructure management, and biosolids/residuals management.
During Hurricane Sandy recovery R3M states it mobilized to provide 24/7 emergency response with contractors, restarting the Sayreville pump station with temporary bypass pumping within 10 days.

Careers page describes R3M as an 'expanding' consulting engineering firm and asks candidates to email qualifications plus cover letter to a general inbox (r3minfo@r3m-eng.com); no job listings or ATS are linked from it.

Job posting for WASTEWATER SENIOR PROJECT MANAGER in the Old Bridge office requires NJ PE, 10-15 years experience, managing schedules/budgets across multiple projects and reporting status to clients and management; lists experience with Project Management Information Systems including Deltek Vision as a plus.

Job posting for Wastewater Process Engineer in the Old Bridge office requires NJ PE and 5-10 years of water/wastewater consulting experience covering treatment, odor control, biosolids and reclaimed water systems.

Firm's own site carries separate job pages for Water & Wastewater Senior Engineer, Civil Engineer, Senior Structural Engineer, Water Systems Engineer, Wastewater Process Engineer and Water/Wastewater Project Engineer; the Civil and Structural postings state R3M wants 'key individuals with proven experience and relationships to help grow our practice.'

Notable project clients include Middlesex County Utilities Authority, Bayshore Regional Sewerage Authority, Old Bridge Municipal Utilities Authority, and Hamilton Township Department of Water Pollution Control.
Site is WordPress with the All in One SEO plugin (v5.0.5 per the dynamically generated sitemap); page sitemap lastmod dates cluster in 2022 and October 2024, with no news/blog section listed.

operations_signals: Client contact is phone (732-679-7100), fax (732-679-7110) or a 'Write Us a Message' web form that also handles consultation scheduling requests — no online booking, portal or client login (https://r3m-eng.com/contact-us/).
No stated office hours on the contact page; address and Google Maps embed only, single Old Bridge office serving central New Jersey authorities and municipalities (https://r3m-eng.com/contact-us/).

Emergency/after-hours capability is advertised around storm events — '24/7 emergency response' with contractors during Sandy recovery — implying manual, phone-based emergency escalation rather than a ticketing system (https://r3m-eng.com/projects/).

Job applications and general inquiries funnel into one general email address (r3minfo@r3m-eng.com) or physical mail to the office; senior PM posting asks resumes be sent 'in confidence' to a Human Resources Manager by mail or email, suggesting no ATS (https://r3m-eng.com/careers/).

Project delivery is Engineer-of-Record style work for authorities/municipalities: planning, design, permitting, construction-phase services, startup and funding coordination with FEMA and NJEIT (https://acecnj.org/member_directory/r3m-engineering-inc/).

Project managers are expected to track multiple project schedules, budgets and scopes and report status to both client and company management — coordination-heavy reporting work (https://www.simplyhired.com/job/Fv0nOISZbI2c9R6bku2m6mkJXDLBvzmxdz0RRrfGPviYQair__IwYg).
hiring_signals: Six engineer-focused job pages hosted on the firm's own site (senior water/wastewater, civil, senior structural, water systems, wastewater process, water/wastewater project engineer), sitemap last modified October 2024 (https://r3m-eng.com/page-sitemap.xml).

Senior Project Manager opening: 10-15 years experience, must oversee multiple concurrent public-utility projects, maintain schedules/budgets, report status, mentor staff and develop new business (https://www.simplyhired.com/job/Fv0nOISZbI2c9R6bku2m6mkJXDLBvzmxdz0RRrfGPviYQair__IwYg).

Wastewater Process Engineer opening: 5-10 years experience, report writing, plant inspection/testing, design and bid document preparation (https://www.simplyhired.com/job/CmVaI7LsexwJ9OupGyvBQSCYSdblnkTVhwCgSv3RTUePDpCehc5RzQ).

Civil Engineer page explicitly frames hiring as growth hiring: 'looking to bring on key individuals with proven experience and relationships to help grow our practice' (https://r3m-eng.com/civil-engineer/).

Senior Structural Engineer page adds business-development duties — 'support business development pursuits, identifying opportunities and preparing proposals to meet R3M's growth goals' — pointing to proposal volume as a workload (https://r3m-eng.com/senior-structural-engineer/).
Third-party job aggregator listings mirror the same openings; a search-result snippet for Glassdoor stated R3M had 2 open positions (https://www.glassdoor.com/Jobs/R3M-Engineering-Jobs-E2957341.htm).
No operations-support roles (scheduler, dispatcher, billing/AR, marketing, admin) appear in postings — hiring is entirely billable engineering (https://r3m-eng.com/careers/).
review_themes: No consumer review corpus found: Google/Yelp/BBB-style review pages were not readable for this firm, and Indeed and Glassdoor returned HTTP 403 to direct fetches (https://www.indeed.com/cmp/R3m-Engineering).

A search-result snippet on Indeed's New Jersey locations page displayed a 3.0 rating for the Old Bridge office; volume and content of reviews could not be verified (https://www.indeed.com/cmp/R3m-Engineering/locations/NJ).

Client voice is instead expressed through project case studies and awards — e.g., an ACEC NJ honor award and authority ribbon-cutting coverage linked from the firm's projects page — rather than star ratings (https://r3m-eng.com/projects/).
tech_footprint: WordPress website (All in One SEO v5.0.5 plugin signature in the sitemap) with images served from a WP Engine host domain (https://r3m-eng.com/page-sitemap.xml).
Contact page uses a basic message form plus a Google Maps iframe; no scheduling widget, chat widget, CRM form routing or client portal is visible (https://r3m-eng.com/contact-us/).

Deltek Vision named as a desirable Project Management Information System in the Senior PM posting — evidence of a Deltek-based PM/financial stack, though incumbency is not confirmed (https://www.simplyhired.com/job/Fv0nOISZbI2c9R6bku2m6mkJXDLBvzmxdz0RRrfGPviYQair__IwYg).
Still publishes a fax number as a primary contact channel (https://r3m-eng.com/contact-us/).
Content footprint is thin and dated: project and service pages last modified 2022, job pages 2022-2024, no blog, newsroom, case-study feed or downloadable data (https://r3m-eng.com/page-sitemap.xml).
Careers/recruiting runs on a mailto address rather than an ATS or LinkedIn-integrated pipeline (https://r3m-eng.com/careers/).
growth_signals: ACEC New Jersey 2022 Engineering Excellence Honor Award for the Sayreville Pump Station flood-mitigation and permanent-restoration project (https://r3m-eng.com/).

Portfolio anchored by large capital programs: $68M Sayreville rebuild with 10 MW standby power, 23-facility Bayshore Regional Sewerage Authority Sandy recovery, and pipeline/interceptor work for Old Bridge MUA (https://r3m-eng.com/projects/).
Firm self-describes as 'an expanding Consulting Engineering Firm' on its careers page (https://r3m-eng.com/careers/).

Hiring language stresses growth: bringing on individuals 'with proven experience and relationships to help grow our practice' and supporting 'business development pursuits' and proposal preparation (https://r3m-eng.com/senior-structural-engineer/).
Employee count of 27 in the ACEC NJ profile is above the ~23 the mapper noted, consistent with recent additions (https://acecnj.org/member_directory/r3m-engineering-inc/).

Service mix expanded into funding/regulatory coordination (FEMA, NJEIT, USEPA, NJDEP, USACE interface) alongside classic design work — a compliance and grant-administration workload (https://r3m-eng.com/projects/).
decision_maker: Michael J. Samuel, P.E. — listed as the firm's primary contact in the R3M Engineering profile on the ACEC New Jersey member directory (no separate title given); source: https://acecnj.org/member_directory/r3m-engineering-inc/

inferences.inference: Proposal and qualification-statement production is a significant, recurring manual workload.
inferences.reasoning: The firm sells to authorities and municipalities that procure via RFQ/RFP, its structural-engineer posting explicitly assigns 'preparing proposals to meet R3M's growth goals', and it employs no visible marketing or proposal staff among its postings.

inferences.inference: Resume and inquiry intake is triaged by hand in a shared inbox.
inferences.reasoning: All applications go to r3minfo@r3m-eng.com or physical mail with a cover letter, and six separate job pages exist with no ATS, so sorting and keyword-screening of candidates is likely manual.

inferences.inference: Project status reporting is assembled manually from Deltek plus spreadsheets.
inferences.reasoning: The Senior PM role is responsible for tracking schedules, budgets and scopes and 'reporting status to both client and company management personnel', with Deltek Vision familiarity listed as a plus rather than a requirement — suggesting partial or inconsistent system use.

inferences.inference: After-hours and emergency intake depends on staffed phones rather than automated triage.
inferences.reasoning: The firm advertises 24/7 emergency response during storm events and publishes only phone/fax/web-form contact channels, with no service desk, ticketing or on-call escalation tooling visible.

inferences.inference: Regulatory and funding-assistance work creates document-heavy compliance tracking that is likely spreadsheet-based.
inferences.reasoning: Projects involved FEMA Project Worksheets, hazard-mitigation proposals and NJEIT/SAIL loan funding across many facilities; the firm markets 'Regulatory Coordination and Funding Assistance' as a service line but shows no compliance or grant-tracking software.

inferences.inference: Marketing and business-development content is under-invested, leaving room for AI-assisted case-study and capability-statement generation.
inferences.reasoning: Site pages and job pages have not been updated since 2022-2024, there is no blog or news section in the sitemap, and the strongest credential (ACEC award) appears only as a homepage badge and one project bullet.

data_gaps: Indeed (HTTP 403) and Glassdoor (HTTP 403) blocked direct access, so review volume, ratings and employee-review themes could not be verified; no Google or Yelp review page could be read.

ZoomInfo (403) and BBB (403) profiles were inaccessible, so revenue estimate and headcount could not be cross-checked; the only employee count obtained is 27 from the ACEC NJ profile (mapper noted ~23).
The mapper's note that a principal engineer was added in 2026 could not be confirmed from any source opened; no 2026 news item or press release was found.

The firm's own site does not name any owner, president or principal — no leadership/team page exists (both /team/ and /our-team/ return 404), so the decision-maker name comes from the association directory profile only and no title was stated there.
No information found on office hours, after-hours answering arrangements, service-area boundaries, pricing/rate structure, annual revenue, or client-portal usage.
Tapinto local news coverage of the Sayreville ribbon cutting (linked from the firm's site) returned HTTP 403, so the project completion date and quotes could not be independently confirmed.
Web search providers were rate-limited or unconfigured for most of this session; additional job-board and news coverage may exist that was not surfaced.
